metadata.title: [FEATURE]: Gate public visibility by ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY flag in team scope
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

## 🔗 Epic / Issue
Closes #3286

---

## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences)

Adds an `ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY` platform flag (default `true`) that, when set to `false`, prevents entities from being saved with `public` visibility when the request is team-scoped (URL or form contains `team_id`). The restriction is enforced consistently in the backend API, the admin UI HTML, and the JavaScript edit modals.

---

## 🧪 Checks

- [x] `make lint` passes
- [x] `make test` passes

---

## 📓 Notes

### Behaviour

| Scope | `ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY=true` | `ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY=false` |
|---|---|---|
| Global (no `team_id`) | public selectable | public selectable |
| Team-scoped (`team_id` present) | public selectable | public **disabled / rejected** |

The rule applies uniformly to servers, tools, resources, prompts, gateways, A2A agents, and gRPC services.

### Changes

**`mcpgateway/config.py`**
- New `allow_public_visibility: bool` field (default `True`).

**`mcpgateway/admin.py`**
- New helper `_check_public_visibility_allowed(visibility, team_id)` — raises HTTP 422 only when `allow_public_visibility=False` **and** `team_id` is present.
- All 14 add/edit handler call sites updated; A2A add guard moved before schema construction so it is not swallowed by broad exception handlers.
- `except HTTPException: raise` added in four handlers that previously swallowed it.

**`mcpgateway/templates/admin.html`**
- Removed static Jinja `{% if allow_public_visibility %}…{% endif %}` `disabled` rendering on all public radio inputs; radios are always rendered enabled.
- `window.ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY` injected once via `{{ allow_public_visibility | tojson }}`.

**`mcpgateway/static/admin.js`**
- `updateDefaultVisibility()` now reads `window.ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY` and the URL `team_id` param to toggle `disabled`, `opacity-40`, `cursor-not-allowed`, and `line-through` on public radio wrappers dynamically.
- All six edit-modal coerce blocks updated: public visibility is only coerced to `team` when `ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY === false` **and** `teamId` is present in the URL.

**`charts/mcp-stack/values.yaml`**
- Added `ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY: "true"` entry.

**Tests**
- `TestPublicVisibilityGuard` (Python): block tests pass `team_id`; new `*_allows_public_when_flag_false_no_team_id` tests confirm global scope is never blocked.
- `tests/js/admin-forms.test.js`: rewrote `ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY flag` describe block to call `updateDefaultVisibility()` with `history.replaceState` URL simulation.
- `tests/js/admin-edit-server-selection.test.js`: fixed `mockServerFetch` to include `clone` method; updated coercion tests to reflect global-scope behaviour.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
## Review Summary

Rebased onto `main`, resolved 1 merge conflict, squashed 17 commits into 2 clean ones, and fixed several issues.

### Bug Fixed: HTTPException Swallowed in 8 Handlers

The original PR added `except HTTPException: raise` to only 4 handlers but missed **8 others**. Without this, the visibility guard's `HTTPException(422)` gets caught by the broad `except Exception` and returned as a **500 error** instead of the intended 422.

Fixed in: `admin_add_server`, `admin_add_tool`, `admin_edit_tool`, `admin_add_gateway`, `admin_add_resource`, `admin_edit_resource`, `admin_add_prompt`, `admin_edit_prompt`.

### Cleanup Applied

- Reverted unrelated cosmetic changes in `config.py` (~8 string concatenation reformats)
- Reverted unrelated HTML reformatting in `admin_get_user_edit`
- Reverted unrelated docstring additions to 3 existing handlers
- Removed debug `console.log` statements from JS test
- Fixed misleading `.env.example` comment ("Block public visibility" → "Allow entities to have public visibility")
- Added missing `test_create_grpc_service_allows_public_when_flag_false_no_team_id` test
- Updated `config.py` description to mention team scope restriction

### Design Gap to Discuss

Issue #3286 says _"no user can create or update any entity with `visibility=public`"_ (global block), but the PR implements a **narrower team-scoped block** — the guard requires `team_id` to be present:
```python
if not settings.allow_public_visibility and visibility == "public" and team_id:
```

This means global admin scope (no `team_id`) always allows public visibility even with the flag set to `false`. The PR title and description explicitly document this behavior, but it diverges from the issue. **@madhav165** — is this intentional? If so, the issue description should be updated to reflect the team-scoped design.

### Minor Gaps (Non-blocking)

1. **gRPC update guard is dead code**: `GrpcServiceUpdate` schema lacks `team_id`, so `getattr(service, "team_id", None)` always returns `None` and the guard never fires for gRPC updates.

2. **Test coverage**: All 22 Python tests and 74 JS tests pass. Coverage is good across all entity types for both block and pass-through scenarios.

commits.message:
feat: gate public visibility by ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY flag in team scope

Add ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY platform flag (default true) that prevents
entities from being saved with public visibility when the request is
team-scoped (team_id present). Enforced in backend admin handlers, the
admin UI (JS dynamic radio gating), and edit modals (legacy-public
coercion). Applies to servers, tools, resources, prompts, gateways,
A2A agents, and gRPC services.

Closes #3286

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

  admin_add_server, admin_add_tool, admin_edit_tool, admin_add_gateway,
  admin_add_resource, admin_edit_resource, admin_add_prompt, and
  admin_edit_prompt. Without this, the visibility guard's 422 would be
  swallowed and returned as a 500.
- Revert unrelated cosmetic changes (config.py string concatenation
  reformats, admin_get_user_edit HTML reformatting, docstring additions).
- Fix .env.example comment to accurately describe the flag behavior.
- Remove debug console.log statements from JS test.
- Add missing test_create_grpc_service_allows_public_when_flag_false_no_team_id.
- Update config.py description to mention team scope restriction.
